title: Kshitij x Ankahi: Two Societies. One Street.
summary: A collaboration between Gargi College’s StreetPlay Society — Kshitij and Ankahi Dramatics Club IIT Delhi, bringing together two passionate theatre communities for an evening of street theatre and expression.

title: THE SEAGULL
summary: Love is complicated. Art is cruel. Dreams have consequences. A story of love, art, ambition, and the quiet wreckage they leave behind. In a world where everyone longs for something they cannot have, dreams collide, hearts unravel, and the stage becomes a mirror to life. Anton Chekhov’s timeless exploration of longing, failure, and desire.
